state:
**Side goal `test-scratch-and-hover`: stage 3 is done, and stage 2 is the only work left.** Hover answers on a `use` line, an `extends`/`implements` clause and a written type (`crates/nvs-lsp/src/hover.rs`, `name`). *Find References* lists `use` lines and the CodeLens does not count them (`SymbolIndex::imports_of` in `crates/nvs-lsp/src/index.rs`), stated in `rule:ide/five-features-are-one-reference-index`. The check `hover-references-and-lens-cases` passes.

`nvs_repo::scratch(name) -> Scratch` (`crates/nvs-repo/src/lib.rs`) is a fresh directory `target/test-scratch/<name>-<pid>-<n>`, deleted when the guard drops. `nvs_repo::scratch_private(name)` is `case/` inside one such directory locked to this account, for a test that runs the ownership check. The guard `no_test_code_writes_into_the_system_temp_dir` is in `crates/nvs-repo/tests/scratch.rs`, with `SUBJECT` (empty) and the `NOT_YET_MOVED` ratchet. Moving a site means lowering or deleting its row in the same commit.

**Moved: all of `nvs-cli`, `nvs-lsp`, `nvs-runtime`, `nvs-hir` and `nvs-types`, and `nvs-config/tests/trust.rs`.** Calls left: `nvs-stdlib` (16 rows), `nvs-db`, `nvs-footprint`, `nvs-host`, `nvs-test`, and the two Unix socket paths below. A test `TempDir` struct holds `path: nvs_repo::Scratch` and has no `Drop` of its own. `Scratch` is not `Clone`, so a `dir.path.clone()` becomes `dir.path.to_path_buf()`. A site whose code deletes the directory itself (a sweep test) keeps the guard alive and works in `dir.join("standing")`.

**Two Unix socket paths are not moved, on purpose:** `crates/nvs-config/tests/control.rs:49` and `crates/nvs-server/src/serve.rs:7456` (`one_connection_over_a_unix_socket_gets_the_same_response`, `#[cfg(unix)]`). A socket path is limited to about 104 bytes on macOS, and a path under `target/test-scratch/` in a deep checkout can pass that. Moving them, or listing them in `SUBJECT` with that reason, is the user's call. `crates/nvs-lsp/src/suite.rs:339` (`Materialised::write`, the `lsp-test` runner) writes each case into the system temp directory; it is not test code, so the guard does not see it.
